tracesTo: UserFlow: Manager / Fan Onboarding, Claiming & Role Assignment

stories.title: Register New Account with Email and Password
stories.goal: create an FSHQ account using my email and password
stories.benefit: I can establish my identity and access league spaces
acceptanceCriteria: User can enter email address and password in registration form
System validates email format and password strength (minimum 8 characters)
System creates new user account via Supabase Auth signup
System sends verification email to provided email address
User receives confirmation message with instructions to verify email
System prevents duplicate accounts with same email address

stories.title: Verify Email Address After Registration
stories.goal: verify my email address to activate my account
stories.benefit: I can confirm my identity and gain full access to FSHQ features
acceptanceCriteria: User receives verification email with secure token link
User can click verification link to confirm email address
System validates verification token via Supabase Auth
System updates user account status to verified upon successful validation
User is redirected to login page or automatically logged in after verification
System provides option to resend verification email if not received

stories.title: Login with Email and Password
stories.goal: sign in to my FSHQ account using my email and password
stories.benefit: I can access my leagues and participate in league activities
acceptanceCriteria: User can enter email and password in login form
System authenticates credentials via Supabase Auth signIn
System creates secure session with JWT token upon successful authentication
User is redirected to appropriate landing page based on league membership status
System displays clear error messages for invalid credentials
System prevents login if email is not verified with option to resend verification

stories.title: Maintain Authenticated Session
stories.goal: stay signed in across browser sessions without repeated login
stories.benefit: I have convenient access to FSHQ without logging in each time I visit
acceptanceCriteria: System maintains user session using Supabase Auth session management
Session persists across browser tabs and page refreshes
System validates session token on each protected route access
Session automatically refreshes before expiration to maintain continuity
System provides option to 'Remember Me' for extended session duration
Session expires after configurable inactivity period for security

stories.title: Logout and End Session
stories.goal: securely sign out of my FSHQ account
stories.benefit: I can protect my account when using shared devices or ending my session
acceptanceCriteria: User can access logout option from navigation menu or user profile
System clears authentication session via Supabase Auth signOut
System removes session tokens and cookies from browser
User is redirected to login page or public homepage after logout
System prevents access to protected routes after logout
Logout action is immediate and does not require page refresh

stories.title: Request Password Reset
stories.goal: reset my password when I cannot remember it
stories.benefit: I can regain access to my account without contacting support
acceptanceCriteria: User can access 'Forgot Password' link from login page
User can enter their email address to request password reset
System sends password reset email via Supabase Auth resetPasswordForEmail
System provides confirmation that reset email was sent (without revealing if account exists)
Reset email contains secure token link valid for limited time period
System prevents brute force attempts with rate limiting on reset requests

stories.title: Complete Password Reset Process
stories.goal: set a new password using the reset link from my email
stories.benefit: I can choose a new password and regain access to my account
acceptanceCriteria: User can click reset link from email and be directed to secure password reset form
System validates reset token for authenticity and expiration
User can enter and confirm new password meeting strength requirements
System updates password via Supabase Auth updateUser
User is logged in automatically after successful password reset
System invalidates reset token after use to prevent reuse
System displays error if reset token is expired or invalid with option to request new one

stories.title: Handle Authentication Errors Gracefully
stories.goal: understand authentication issues and how to resolve them
stories.benefit: I can troubleshoot login problems without frustration or confusion
acceptanceCriteria: System displays user-friendly error messages for common auth failures (wrong password, account not found, unverified email)
Error messages do not expose sensitive security information
System provides actionable guidance for each error type (e.g., 'Try password reset' for wrong password)
System logs authentication errors for security monitoring without blocking user
System implements rate limiting on failed login attempts to prevent brute force attacks
System provides contact support option for persistent authentication issues

stories.title: Protect Routes Based on Authentication Status
stories.goal: enforce access control based on user authentication and verification status
stories.benefit: protected resources are only accessible to authenticated users
acceptanceCriteria: System checks authentication status before allowing access to protected routes
Unauthenticated users are redirected to login page when accessing protected routes
System preserves intended destination URL to redirect after successful login
Public routes (login, register, forgot password) remain accessible without authentication
System validates session on server-side for API routes to prevent token manipulation
System handles expired sessions gracefully with automatic redirect to login

stories.title: Display User Account Information
stories.goal: view my account details and authentication status
stories.benefit: I can verify my account information and manage my profile
acceptanceCriteria: User can access account settings or profile page
System displays email address associated with account
System shows email verification status clearly
System displays account creation date and last login time
User can initiate password change from account settings
System masks or securely displays sensitive information
